benchmark: CDVQA (real official test split, over SECOND dataset images)
model: change.siamese_binary_cnn (Siamese CNN, binary change/no-change, siamese-cnn-v1) — id was 'change.semantic_model' when this run was made
note: SatQuery's change specialists measure aggregate change coverage, not per-land-cover-class semantic change; the learned Siamese CNN is a BINARY change/no-change model. Low scores on categorical question types (smallest/largest/change_to_what) are an expected, honest capability gap, not a bug — closing it needs a per-class (semantic) change model, which this project has not trained.

change_ratio.metric: percentage_bucket_accuracy (11 buckets, extracts a real % from free text)

change_ratio_types.metric: percentage_bucket_accuracy (11 buckets, extracts a real % from free text)

approx_overall_accuracy_note: Computed over SCORED answers only; the deterministic baseline scored 15 answers (4 correct) and this run scored 28 (9 correct), so the two overall numbers are not like-for-like. Per-type n is 13-15, so single-type differences are within sampling noise.
evaluated_with: Change-specialist implementation as of commits c4a5fda/ecd5116 (before the honesty hardening: older answer wording, no domain gating). Re-run to refresh against the current code.
possible_contamination: CDVQA's 968 test pairs are a subset of SECOND's 2,968 pairs and the change model was trained on 2,000 of them (2,968-968=2,000 would fit a deliberate exclusion, but that is unconfirmed); unless data prep excluded the CDVQA test pairs, some evaluated images were seen in training. Not yet checked (ml/change_model/check_cdvqa_leakage.py).
